scope: Exact Ubuntu linux 7.0.0-43.43 source/build reconciliation for six residuals; no new server tests or changes

kernel.source_finding: No persistent VMA pointer; vm_start/address lookup under mmap/per-VMA locking; binder built as module.

historical_barrier.evidence: Binder er modulbasert. Ingen binder-modul, enhet eller binderfs-mount observert.

kernel.next_action: No kernel action; optional Canonical tracker correction. Reassess for changed source/build or corrected CVE scope.

kernel.source_finding: No fs/ntfs source or Ubuntu patch addition, no legacy build rule/module/builtin; ntfs3 distinct. CONFIG_NTFS_FS=m text does not establish a built driver.

historical_barrier.evidence: Ingen NTFS-mount i SSH-namespace. Ny mount av ubetrodd volum endrer vurderingen.

kernel.next_action: No kernel action; reassess on driver reintroduction or changed source/build/CVE scope.

kernel.source_finding: Wrong percpu map_meta_equal callback lacks max_entries comparison; x86 per-CPU JIT supported, BPF/JIT built in.

historical_barrier.evidence: Nye uprivilegerte BPF-kall er sperret av sysctl=2. API/gate har ingen capabilities. Tracefs er root 0700 og perf_event_paranoid=4. Krever tillatt BPF/tracing-bruk med de konkrete verifier-, map-, trampoline-, destructor- eller fprobe-forutsetningene. Eksisterende privilegerte programmer og delegerte objekter ble ikke attestert.

kernel.next_action: Await supported Ubuntu backport; if runtime exposure must be resolved first, inventory existing/delegated map-in-map objects and access, not general stress testing.

kernel.source_finding: amdgpu_userq uses xa_store_irq rather than rejecting duplicate doorbell with xa_insert_irq; userq compiled in amdgpu module.

historical_barrier.evidence: AMDGPU var ikke lastet eller bundet. Vertens GPU-drivere er i915 og nouveau.

kernel.next_action: Await supported Ubuntu backport; complete hardware/driver evidence could separately narrow host exposure. Reassess before AMD GPU/driver access.

kernel.source_finding: No higher-order fallback; put_page precedes folio_order; source-page population helper absent; DRM_GPUSVM=m and ZONE_DEVICE=y.

historical_barrier.evidence: Kbuild legger drm_pagemap i drm_gpusvm_helper med CONFIG_DRM_GPUSVM=m. Hjelperen og xe var fraværende, og i915/nouveau har ikke den avhengigheten. Nouveau SVM er avslått. GPU-bruk alene oppfyller ikke pagemap-migreringstriggeren.

kernel.next_action: Await full supported backport including fallback, lifetime order and source-page population. Reassess before GPU/SVM changes.

kernel.source_finding: Session register still removes idle valid sessions after 10*HZ; missing credential-expiration/45-second setup semantics; SMB_SERVER=m.

historical_barrier.evidence: KSMBD var ikke lastet. Krever SMB-serverens konkrete låse-, oplock- eller sesjonsbane.

kernel.next_action: Await supported full session/connection fix; reassess before ksmbd/SMB server or module-policy changes.
